Headline: #28 Stony Island Temporary Northbound Reroute near Stony Island/81st
ShortDescription: NB 28 Stony Island buses are temporarily rerouted, due to street blockage near Stony Island/81st.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Northbound #28 Stony Island buses are temporarily rerouted via Stony Island, Anthony, 81st, South Chicago, Stony Island and over normal route due to street blockage near Stony Island/81st.
